sources.title: Outlook Immutable Id
sources.text: To save email resume properly, i need immutable id to reference original email of the resume.
taskExcerpts: To save email resume properly, i need immutable id to reference original email of the resume.

spans.text: My use case: To save email resume properly, i need immutable id to reference original email of the resume. This allow me to build a system where every single new email is resume like : “X person ask X person if there is a possibility to do X in comparaison of original X” This remove more than 80% of useless token and simplify the context for smaller llm to understand a long email conversation with many ping pong and person inside. I use it to create draft prefill with the good knowledge + compact history of the conversation with each mail resume Any resources to support this? Are you willing to work on this? It’s already done, check out here and feel free to ask me ANYTHING that could increase the speed for a merge, i think this feature is very light but very important when you realise how microsoft manage by default id that can change for no technical reason…

sources.title: How Can I Automate Booking and Service Provider Notifications in an On-Demand App Using n8n?
sources.text: How can n8n help automate booking confirmations, provider assignment notifications, payment status updates, and customer alerts?
taskExcerpts: How can n8n help automate booking confirmations, provider assignment notifications, payment status updates, and customer alerts?

spans.text: I’m exploring ways to automate workflows for an on-demand service application that connects customers with service providers. How can n8n help automate booking confirmations, provider assignment notifications, payment status updates, and customer alerts? Can webhooks and integrations with external APIs handle these processes efficiently? I’d also like to understand how to manage failed workflows, retry unsuccessful requests, and prevent duplicate notifications when multiple bookings arrive simultaneously. What workflow structure and best practices would you recommend for building a reliable automation system?

sources.title: Email Sortierung -IMAP-Problem
sources.text: I’ve only recently started working with n8n and I’m currently working on a workflow for automatic email sorting.
taskExcerpts: I’ve only recently started working with n8n and I’m currently working on a workflow for automatic email sorting.

spans.text: I’ve only recently started working with n8n and I’m currently working on a workflow for automatic email sorting. I’m having a problem with my Code Node and the subsequent IF Node. My Code Node apparently doesn’t reliably recognize emails that contain certain text. Additionally, the IF Node doesn’t output the Boolean value (true or false) as expected, so the emails aren’t being sorted correctly. Unfortunately, I haven’t been able to find the cause so far. Does anyone have experience with this problem and can give me a tip on how to configure my workflow correctly?
What is the error message (if any)?
Share the output returned by the last node
